title: Function `poolManager.sync` called before the unlock process
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  In the `BunniHook` contract, there is a function call to `poolManager.sync` at line `BunniHook#L501`, which comes before the initiation of an `unlock` process at line `BunniHook#L505`.  ```solidity File: BunniHook.sol 465:     function rebalanceOrderPostHook(RebalanceOrderHookArgs calldata hookArgs) external override nonReentrant { ... ... 500:         // posthook should wrap output tokens as claim tokens and push it from BunniHook to BunniHub and update pool balances 501:>>>      poolManager.sync(args.currency); 502:
